# Compass-360 AI Advisory

> Compass-360 is a vendor-neutral enterprise AI advisory consultancy serving CIOs, CDOs, and CEOs in the GCC/MENA region and the United States. Founded by Ali Dahmash, Tampa FL.

## Services

- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://compass-360.ai/ai-readiness-assessment): Proprietary SAiGE 5-step framework that evaluates enterprise AI maturity across data, governance, culture, and technology. Delivers a clear scorecard in 48 hours.
- [AI Strategy & Roadmap](https://compass-360.ai/ai-strategy-roadmap): End-to-end AI strategy development and multi-year roadmap for enterprise organizations aligning AI investment with business objectives.
- [AI Advisory & Consulting](https://compass-360.ai/ai-advisory-consulting): Ongoing fractional AI advisory for C-suite leadership teams — vendor neutral, no platform commissions.
- [AI Enablement & Governance](https://compass-360.ai/ai-enablement-governance): Enterprise AI governance frameworks aligned to ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF. Policy design, risk management, and responsible AI adoption.
- [Enterprise AI Training](https://compass-360.ai/enterprise-ai-training): Role-based AI literacy and upskilling programs for enterprise teams — leadership tracks and functional tracks.

## Key Differentiators

- Vendor-neutral: No product or platform commission relationships
- GCC/MENA specialist: Deep expertise in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman AI regulatory environments
- 5-step SAiGE framework: Proprietary AI Readiness Assessment methodology
- 48-hour turnaround: AI Readiness Assessment scorecard delivered in 48 hours
- Right-sized for mid-market: Not a Big 4 firm — direct access to senior advisors
